test: fraction of the step each of the FOUR feet is on the ground
method: foot site within 4 mm of the floor, 800 steps, seed 1, habitat world. One consistent measure across all four configurations -- earlier comparisons used the env's own front-duty metric and only looked at the two front feet.

lab + NO policy.note: all four even, and all four near target. THE ACCEPTED WALKER.

legacy + policy.note: front near target, HIND FEET AT HALF. This is what every video in this session was filmed with.

lab + policy.note: worst of the four, front gap 0.264

verdict: The user said the walking was wrong again and was right again. The clip was filmed with legacy+policy, whose HIND feet carry load for 0.37-0.44 of the step against a published 0.765 -- barely half. I had only ever measured the FRONT pair, so the defect was outside the metric I was checking. lab+no-policy puts all four feet at 0.76-0.79, even to within 0.006.
why_it_kept_happening: GeckoBrainEnv defaults to gait_profile='legacy' and always loads the frozen residual. The accepted walker is lab + zero residual. Nothing in the brain env could express that combination until now.
